inputs.label: Run the three supplied standard-code examples
inputs.prompt: Run the supplied codon-count, RSCU, and CAI optimization examples on their built-in in-frame standard-code sequences and verify the optimized protein.

inputs.label: Alternate genetic code 2
inputs.prompt: Build and use a vertebrate-mitochondrial CAI index, score TGG, and optimize TGA while preserving its table-2 translation.

inputs.label: Empty partial shifted and ambiguous inputs
inputs.prompt: Analyze empty, one- or two-base trailing partial, shifted-frame, ambiguous-codon, stop-containing, and ATG/TGG-only inputs and report every rejection or discard.

inputs.label: CAI tie stop and pseudocount semantics
inputs.prompt: Verify Biopython 1.85 strict and non-strict tie handling, stop-codon contribution to CAI, and the normalized weight assigned to an unobserved synonymous codon.

inputs.label: Simplified Nc versus codonW
inputs.prompt: Compare the documented simplified Nc helper with codonW on a heterogeneous synonymous-family fixture and public E. coli thrA CDS, and judge cross-study comparability.
